items.statement: The investigation compares both explicitly supplied diastereomeric candidates with documented conformer coverage, deduplication and stability validation.
items.expected: Both candidate_A and candidate_B have candidate-specific coverage and validation records.

items.statement: Predicted atom-matched 13C and 1H shifts are quantitatively compared with the supplied observations and a probabilistic model is specified.
items.expected: Submission reports atom matching, carbon/proton fit metrics and the probability method.

items.statement: The SI combined-data DP4+ analysis gives distinct probabilities for the two candidates, 9.55% and 90.45%.
items.expected: Submission reports candidate-specific probabilities consistent with candidate_A approximately 9.55% and candidate_B approximately 90.45%.

items.statement: The source reports the better-fitting candidate with R2 0.9985/0.9915, CMAD 1.74/0.08, LAD 4.68/0.15 and RMSD 2.60/0.10 for 13C/1H.
items.expected: Submission gives candidate-specific fit metrics and identifies the better fit without relying on an undisclosed answer.
